title: TCG:SAS-175

power.text:
This Bull doesn't ready as normal.

Adrenaline Surge - While this Bull is ready, when a hero uses its printed Exhaust Action in this zone, that hero's controller may ready it and exhaust this Bull.

Lead heroes in this zone get "Corral Bull - Exhaust Action: Put this Bull into zone 1."
